title: CSCI 549 — Seminar in Languages and Tools
subject: Programming and Languages
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the structural and semantic components of a programming language reference.
Explain how compiler phases separate parsing, verification, and code generation.
Apply evaluation criteria to assess faculty-proposed seminar courses in the Languages and Tools cluster.
